name: Exec Cluster Cost: Futures — Per-Contract Commission + Tick Slippage
description: Tests: Futures commission ($1.87/contract) + TickBased slippage (1 tick). Run with --cost futures
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC CLUSTER COST: Futures Commission + Tick Slippage
# Run with: --cost futures --cash 100000
# Validates: per-contract commission (exchange+clearing+NFA+broker), tick-based slippage
# =============================================================================

src = study_assets()

cont = futures_continuation(
    s_rollover_method=RolloverType.FirstOfMonth,
    s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.BackwardRatio
)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

close = cont.c
atr_val = atr(cont.h, cont.l, cont.c, 14)

# === SIGNAL: Donchian breakout ===
donchian = donchian_channel(cont.h, cont.l, window=20)
upper = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
entry_long = close > upper
held = hold_until(entry_long, close < donchian.donchian_lower)

# === EXECUTION ===
rollover_policy()(active=cont.s)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held)
risk_unit(stop_unit=StopUnit.price, contract_multiplier=50)(
    risk_pct=2, stop_distance=atr_val * 2
)
trailing_stop()(distance=atr_val * 3)
